title: Impossible to highlight the selection text in `st.selectbox` to delete it all at once
body:
### Summary

- When using the `st.selectbox`, you cannot highlight the text of the current selection and delete it at once (e.g., using backspace key).
- Sometimes it lets you highlight the selection text, but only when `st.selectbox` is not in focus (so backspace key doesn't do anything).
- This means users are only able to delete any selection letter by letter.

### Steps to reproduce

[![Open in Streamlit Cloud](https://static.streamlit.io/badges/streamlit_badge_black_white.svg)](https://issues.streamlitapp.com/?issue=gh-5240)

Code snippet:

```
import streamlit as st
st.selectbox('Example options',options = ('option 1','option 2','option 3'))
```

**Expected behavior:**

The current selection text in `st.selectbox` can be highlighted while in focus (and e.g., deleted at once using backspace key). 

### Is this a regression?

No

### Additional information

This is one of several UX issues detected for `st.selectbox`. Others are:

- #4671 
- #4901

comments.body:
Hi [USER] , thanks for submitting this issue. This seems like more of an enhancement rather than a bug. However, this does seem like an odd thing and this would probably have to be looked into and prioritized by product. 

As a workaround, you can click on it, do one backspace and then do a command + a or ctrl + a in order to select everything and backspace. 

Let me know if you still think this is a bug and we can have that discussion and I bring it up to the team.
not sure if it's my imagination but seems like this issue might be fixed in streamlit 1.39 ...
This will be fixed in Streamlit 1.59+ with the migration of selectbox from baseweb to react-aria.
